meta.name: AI Agent + Builder Experience
meta.goal: Guide an AI to recreate a cohesive marketing + product preview site inspired by the provided references.

designStyle.mood: Calm, confident, modern—mix of soft gradients and high-contrast dark panels.
designStyle.voice: Expert yet approachable; keep copy short and instructive.
designStyle.imagery: Edge-to-edge gradients for marketing heroes, clean mock dashboards with white surfaces and muted borders.

gridAndSpacing.layout: 12-column responsive grid with generous gutters (24px desktop, 16px tablet, 8px mobile).

primary.usage: Headlines, hero input prompts, CTA labels.

secondary.usage: Body copy, button descriptions, card annotations.

usageNotes: Use the light gradient hero for marketing sections; reserve the dark gradient for AI agent callouts.
Always pair #FF6B35 CTA with white text and soft drop shadow (0 8px 20px rgba(255,107,53,0.35)).
Suggestion chips should have low-contrast pastel fills with darker text (#2D2D2D).

hero.pattern: Full-bleed gradient background, centered stack, single oversized input card.
elements: Top nav with pill CTA on the right and globe language icon.
Headline split across two lines; emphasize one keyword with accent color or lighter weight.
Voice-to-text inspired input surface (white, 8px shadow, arrow send button).
Row of suggestion chips underneath with icons.

contentSections.name: Workflow Cards
contentSections.visuals: Rounded rectangles with subtle inner shadows and checkmark lists.

contentSections.name: Agent Builder CTA
contentSections.structure: Split layout: copy on left (dark surface) and stat blocks on right.
contentSections.visuals: Use highlight green for metric deltas; include small avatar or handshake photo for trust signals.

contentSections.name: Dashboard Showcase
contentSections.structure: Overlapping product screenshots with drop shadows and light border frames.
contentSections.visuals: Stack 2–3 dashboard panels with slight rotation to imply depth.

ctaBar.style: Dark pill bar (#0B1324) with twin buttons (primary filled, secondary outlined).

navigation.content: Logo left, product/use-case/resources dropdowns center, CTA + language switch right.
navigation.background: Translucent white (#FFFFFFEE) over hero with 1px border bottom.

heroInput.fields: Single textarea style with placeholder prompt and send arrow button (#FF6B35).

chips.icon: 16px glyph to left, subtle drop shadow.

cards.workflow: White surface, 1px #EDF0F7 border, top badge using accent pastel, check list with green ticks.
cards.testimonial: Muted beige background (#F4EDE1), serif quote highlight optional.

dashboardPanels.toolbar: Light grey (#F9FAFC) top strip with icons, status badge on right.
dashboardPanels.charts: Line chart uses seriesA, bar chart uses seriesB and neutrals, tables use zebra striping (#F6F7FB).

secondary.border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4) or #0F172A on light backgrounds

motionAndEffects.hover: Scale cards by 1.01 with soft shadow transition (200ms).
motionAndEffects.heroGradient: Slow 8s background pan for subtle liveliness.
motionAndEffects.dashboard: Reveal animations from bottom with 250ms delay stagger.

pageFlow: Hero gradient intro with prompt input and quick ideas chips.
Agent builder dark section highlighting reliability stats.
Dashboard collage + KPI cards for proof.
Bottom CTA pill with dual actions (Book a demo / Explore AI Agents).
spacingNotes: Align cards to grid; never bleed them into hero gradient.
Maintain 48px between stacked sections unless noted.
Keep nav and CTA pill aligned with hero input edges.
